scope: Spline ecthr_el/tight acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h on a copy of fits/spline/ecthr_el/tight/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, budgets, sector exclusions, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms from the manual baseline. Misses started on each histogram's cosine. Bins with no manual start kept the stored cosine so the second pass could not pin them. (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_4) rose by 0.163 and left its cosine. Pass 2 put that bin back and refit only Q2-y 9. The other Q2-y bins were not refit again and did not move. JSON still has 452 bins. 45 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 5.65e-06). (1,8) moved from the pinned B=-0.045000, statistical error 0.020299, C=0.003382, error 0.006462, chi-squared 43.388, NDF 13, to B=-0.122907, statistical error 0.034598, C=-0.043234, error 0.031896, chi-squared 38.274, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not a copy of the nominal B=-0.125184.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved onto the nominal. Kept shifts: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.20004 versus nominal -0.15443; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.17301 versus nominal -0.13868. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
unresolved: The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. The retained curve already matches an unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_14) 6.095 (chi2 128.002, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 5.950 (chi2 124.956, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) 5.928 (chi2 124.488, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) 5.409 (chi2 113.594, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 4.872 (chi2 102.306, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) 4.798 (chi2 91.163, NDF 19); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 4.669 (chi2 56.027, NDF 12); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_6) 4.563 (chi2 82.134, NDF 18). why_retained: The final pass is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 45 are lower, and the curves follow each histogram's own cosine. (1,8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. (9,4) was put back because the pass-1 move was worse. The nominal value was not imposed. Fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty. The gray curve on the overlay is the stored fit and the red curve is the retained fit, both drawn on the TF1 range rather than 0-360.
